note: §7.6.1 third branch, both polarities on one isolated unit (own schema build and map per subtest). Positive: an existing presence container and an existing list entry each receive their child leaf's default through ApplyDefaults. Records: positive on applyContainerDefault (revert); negative on the targeted mutant 'c.Presence' -> 'false' (a presence container treated as non-presence), observed red on the ancestor-absent subtest, so the negative discriminates the rule rather than a panic.
